package: one target-bound Leshy2 bundle with six application images and one compatibility/transaction manifest

coordinator.journal: duplicated power-loss-safe bundle transaction record in the S3 local state partition
coordinator.resume_rule: old or pending S3 reconstructs the transaction from the journal and every target's reported bundle/build/pending state before issuing any commit or compensating rollback
coordinator.authority_limit: S3 coordinates the bundle but cannot mark another target healthy or bypass its local signature, self-test, watchdog or rollback owner

signature_contract.status: algorithm and owner-open trust model reviewed; production verifier fit and fault-injection evidence remain F3/F9 gates

preconditions: all actual-TX evidence is quiet and every TX lease is revoked
qualified USB power is stable and the Pack controller permits flash writes
all six application targets identify their current bundle, build and local recovery state
the candidate manifest is target-complete and each old-to-new transport pair satisfies transition_compatibility
staging: create the power-loss-safe S3 transaction journal before changing any inactive slot
stream each target-bound payload to that target only; the target verifies signature, target ID, length and hash before writing
write and read back all six inactive images before any pending boot
require every target to report the expected candidate build ID and a verified inactive slot
abort without changing active slots if any stage or transition-compatibility check fails
pending_boot_rules: Pack and Safety enter pending under their local watchdogs while the known-good S3 and Hub remain active
C5 and RF RP enter pending and must pass local self-test plus their old-S3/old-Hub transition protocol
the RP2350 Try Before You Buy deadline starts when RF RP first enters pending; no earlier step may consume that window
Hub RP enters pending only after every downstream domain is healthy, then proves both old-S3 and candidate-S3 transition compatibility
S3 enters pending last, reconstructs the transaction journal and verifies all six candidate build IDs and self-tests
commit_rule: pending S3 requests local commit in order, reads back each committed state, and commits itself last; the previous image remains physically present on every target until the whole transaction is reconciled

deadline.bounded_by: the earliest active RP2350 Try Before You Buy watchdog window
deadline.fail_closed_rule: F3/F10 must measure boot, self-test, journal and commit worst cases with margin; release is blocked while the qualified budget is null or does not fit

failure_policy.before_any_commit: every pending target returns locally to its last-known-good image; no peer is advanced
failure_policy.during_commit: the journal identifies already committed peers; after restoring a working Hub path, S3 commands those peers back to previous_bundle_id and verifies the compatible previous set
failure_policy.hub_loss: Hub RP local TBYB rollback restores the supervisory path before Pack/Safety reconciliation; independent watchdog and FAULT_KILL remain effective while the path is absent
failure_policy.s3_loss: S3 local rollback restores the previous coordinator, which resumes the journal and reconciles all peers
failure_policy.unrecoverable_target: remain in RUN=KILL with TX leases revoked and require the target's physical recovery path

bridge_rule: a bundle that cannot prove both old-coordinator-to-new-peer and new-coordinator-to-new-peer transition compatibility is rejected; a separately signed intermediate bridge bundle is required
